author: The Current
description:
David Huckfelt talks about choosing songs for "I Was Born, But..."
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Minneapolis singer-songwriter David Huckfelt’s latest album, “I Was Born, But…” is a collection of 17 cover songs that Huckfelt recorded over two days at Dust & Stone Studios in Tucson, Arizona. In a recent interview with Diane, host of The Local Show, Huckfelt describes how he was able to curate that list of 17 songs. 

Huckfelt's album, "I Was Born, But..." is available on @dongiovannirecords .

Find more about Huckfelt's album in this feature at thecurrent.org: https://www.thecurrent.org/feature/2026/01/15/david-huckfelt-keeps-the-memories-of-the-past-alive-on-new-covers-album

author: The Current
description:
Valerie June talks with The Current's Mac Wilson about learning from artists that have come before her.

Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter Valerie June visited The Current studio to play solo acoustic versions of songs from her recent album, 'Owls, Omens and Oracles.' Afterwards, June sat down with The Current’s Mac Wilson to talk about the album and also to share her joyful spirit. “No matter what hard times we face, no matter what difficulties, challenges, we can create this beautiful world for others to appreciate long after we're gone,” June says. “And I think that's the goal.”
